360:t_006:8.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$c will be here any minute! All we have to do is buy time!」

360:t_006:11.en:
$$ギルボア$$
「Don't you die either, $$バナージ$$.」

360:t_007:0.en:
$$レズン$$
「So it's $$ジンネマン$$ of the $$ガランシェール$$! To think you'd forget your grudge against the Federation!」

360:t_007:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$レズン$$... Are you really going to fight for today's $$ネオ・ジオン$$?」

360:t_007:2.en:
$$レズン$$
「I can't stand $$フル・フロンタル$$, that's for sure, but I've got no intention of sucking up to the Federation, and I'm not about to let the $$サイデリアル$$ crush me either.」

360:t_007:3.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...We don't want to be wiped out either. But we can't work up the will to fight for today's $$ネオ・ジオン$$, either.」

360:t_007:4.en:
$$レズン$$
「Then we don't need any more talk! You're my enemies!」

360:t_007:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「That's fine. It's easier on me, too, if you put it that way.」

360:t_007:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
(The light showed us hope... It seems this world still has something to hope for.)

360:t_007:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「Hold the line, $$ジンネマン$$! I'll send troops your way right away!」

360:t_007:10.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「We'll follow the Colonel and $$マリーダ$$ in, too! We're backing up $c!」

360:t_008:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Tch! The $$サイコ・フレーム$$ still hasn't taken to me!」

360:t_009:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Tenacious pests...! They're still holding out!」

360:t_010:1.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「No! It's an indiscriminate attack!」

360:t_011:0.en:
$$カイエン$$
「The $$アルテア$$ army...! No, $$ミカゲ$$'s forces!」

360:t_011:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That guy...! Is he somewhere near here!?」

360:t_011:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「So the meddlers have arrived...! We have no choice but to fall back here!」

360:t_012:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn...! I'm not the kind of man who ends like this!」

360:t_013:0.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Four-Eyes! Weren't we supposed to have taken down that $$ミカゲ$$ guy or whatever!?」

360:t_013:1.en:
$$マリ$$
「Hmm... Looks like he's kept on hating this whole time, even after that fight.」

360:t_013:2.en:
$$カヲル$$
(I suppose so. Feelings carried through a span of time long enough to make one dizzy don't vanish so easily.)

360:t_013:3.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Is that $$ミカゲ$$ guy after the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ too?」

360:t_013:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That's not it...! What he's really after must be...!」

360:t_013:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$, huh...!」

360:t_013:7.en:
$$シェリル$$
「That guy... he still hasn't given up...」

360:t_013:8.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, intercept the army $$ミカゲ$$ sent in!」

360:t_013:9.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「$$ランカ$$... I'll protect you.」

360:t_013:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「Come at us if you want, $$ミカゲ$$! Don't think we'll hand over $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$!」

360:t_013:11.en:
$$マリ$$
「Just like $c... Enemy after enemy keeps showing up, all different kinds...」

360:t_013:12.en:
$$マリ$$
「Looks like this is going to be a melee, $$姫$$.」

360:t_013:13.en:
$$アスカ$$
(...A chance will come in the middle of it...)

360:t_014:0.en:
$$アスカ$$
(...Four-Eyes, let's do it. This is the only chance we'll get.)

360:t_014:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
(...I won't! This is the best choice for Brat $$シンジ$$ and for the world!)

360:t_014:3.en:
$$アスカ$$
(I'll shoot down the EVA he's riding...!)

360:t_015:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The foolishness of the Wingless is beyond salvation now.」

360:t_015:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「You never learn, do you, going after $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ again!」

360:t_015:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's not it, Wingless who longs for wings. Time is still needed before the day of the harvest.」

360:t_015:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The messenger of the end, who came from beyond the natural order... Thanks to that, the dimensional wall guarded by that accursed one has wavered a little.」

360:t_015:9.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「The accursed one he's talking about... must be Supreme Commander $$不動$$...」

360:t_015:11.en:
$$シュレード$$
「What the Supreme Commander is guarding is...」

360:t_015:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh heh... Now the sun will fall to the earth.」

360:t_016:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The dimensional boundary line is warping...!」

360:t_017:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「Is that $$アポロ$$'s $$アクエリオン$$!」

360:t_017:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Since the mark of darkness has been carved into it once, the so-called $$エレメント$$s are no longer needed...」

360:t_017:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now, Wings of the Sun! Give me your power!」

360:t_018:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Did that guy who looks like $$頭翅#pilot$$ do it!」

360:t_018:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's right, Wingless. My hatred stains the Wings of the Sun black.」

360:t_018:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're still going on about that!」

360:t_018:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What could the likes of you understand? My love is deep, and so my hatred is deep as well.」

360:t_018:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That one has already been imprisoned in an eternal prison. Yes... just as the $$天翅$$s were sealed away in $$アトランディア$$ in the past.」

360:t_018:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I thank you, messenger of the end. Thanks to your coming, the laws of the world have warped just a little.」
